tags.DESCRIPTION:
Official video for “GASLIGHT” by WesGhost

Listen & download here: https://wesghost.lnk.to/GASLIGHT

LYRICS:
I'm too sentimental
Still can’t let it go
You don’t like attachments
So cut that rope around my throat
 
Blacked out in the bathroom
Way too many drugs
Your heart is a vacuum
The way you sucked up all my love
 
I'm way too bitter now
I can’t taste you anymore
I'm way too numb
Made me a corpse
Push me down
Til I'm dirt under the floor
Don’t waste my time just tell me
 
How long will I wait
For you to say you love me
Before you’re someone I hate
And everything turns ugly baby
This beds a coffin
And you’re watching while I suffocate
How long will I wait
For you to dig my grave
 
You say its all in my mind
All you do is gaslight gaslight gaslight gaslight
Now its always darkness in your eyes
Think I need a flashlight flashlight flashlight
Manipulate me
Kiss me like you hate me
You say its all in my mind
All you do is gaslight gaslight gaslight gaslight
 
How long will I wait
For you to say you love me
Before you’re someone I hate
And everything turns ugly baby
This beds a coffin
And you’re watching while I suffocate
How long will I wait
For you to dig my grave
 
Teardrops they falling like rain
Bury me while I’m awake
Lie to me straight to my face
Watch you dig my grave
Manipulate me
Kiss me like you hate me
You say it’s all in my mind
All you do is gaslight gaslight gaslight
